# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes land on `master` and ship in the next release of the affected Squid UI
packages. During the alpha series, only the latest published version receives fixes.
The hosted Redstone Squid bot always runs a recent `master`.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report suspected vulnerabilities privately through
[GitHub security advisories](https://github.com/redstone-squid/Redstone-Squid/security/advisories/new)
rather than a public issue. Include what you observed, the affected package or bot surface,
and reproduction steps if you have them.

You should receive an acknowledgement within a week. Once a fix is available we will
coordinate disclosure with you and credit you in the advisory unless you prefer otherwise.
